name: s5cmd
description: Installs s5cmd, a fast S3 and local filesystem client, at an exact version, checked against a sha256 you supply. There are no default pins.

version.description: s5cmd version to install, without the leading v (e.g. 2.3.0). Set it with its sha256 here, or as CLI_S5CMD_VERSION in the image environment, or in the pins file. There is no default.

sha256_amd64.description: sha256 of s5cmd_<version>_Linux-64bit.tar.gz, needed on amd64. Set it here, or as CLI_S5CMD_SHA256_AMD64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

sha256_arm64.description: sha256 of s5cmd_<version>_Linux-arm64.tar.gz, needed on arm64. Set it here, or as CLI_S5CMD_SHA256_ARM64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

pins_file.description: Path of the pins file in the image, read when neither the options nor the image environment set a pin. Empty means /etc/devcontainer-features/pins.env.
